rooms.label: Inside the Barrow
rooms.notes: First barrow room with textured stairs and night-forest skybox.

rooms.label: Carousel Room
rooms.notes: Octagonal rotunda with dusty radial medallion floor, grand light-stone arches, portcullis headers, numbered keystones 1-8, granite piers, and light-stone dome ribs.

rooms.label: Chairman's Office
rooms.notes: Wainscot-aligned peeling plaster walls, dark oak beams/pilasters, mottled grey stone north arch, crimson rug, Hunyuan3D-2 desk, tufted leather chair, dirty vandalized bookcase, and anchor:PORTRAIT.

rooms.label: Shallow Ford
rooms.notes: Continuous organic cavern terrain with full-horizon ford, rising slopes, 180-spire stalagmite forest, recessed winding path, full-width tunnel cliff wall, and cavern skybox.

rooms.label: Top of Well
rooms.notes: Cavern room with textured grey stone well curb, arched eastern tunnel, floor crack, boulders, and anchor:TOP-ETCHINGS.
